name: AGA Cascade 36" Cornwall Green Wall Mounted Range Hood  with Polished Chrome Trim
shortDescription: A large 3 speed blower operating at lower RPM maintains quiet operation, while bright LED lighting (drawing only 6 watts each) offers natural looking, 3000K color spectrum. Electronic touch controls for all the hood features assures overall ease of operation. Color and Trim are Customizable - image shown is not final.

features.text: The commercial-style baffle filters effectively remove airborne contaminants, while detergent inlet holes and grease exit holes guarantee superior dishwasher-safe cleaning.
Large 3 speed blower operates at lower RPM reducing the sound level.
Bright LED lighting offers natural looking, 3000K color spectrum. The 36" hood features 2 lights, the 48” hood features 3 lights.
Electronic touch controls for 3 speed blower and LED lights.
Dishwasher safe, commercial style baffle filters for effectively removing airborne contaminants. Detergent inlet holes and grease exit holes in baffle filters for superior dishwasher cleaning.
Mounting bars at top and bottom allow for attaching to stud supports. Open top and back design for centered duct location or offset top duct and/or rear offset discharge.
LED light bulbs draw only 6 watts each and energy efficient motors draw only 2.5 amps.
